question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **themselves.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the usage of the given reflexive pronouns.
 
• A **reflexive pronoun** is a pronoun used as an object that refers to the same person or thing as the subject.
 
 
• '**T****hemselves**' is used as the object of a verb
